info.name: AISafe - Aircraft Management (distributed)
info.description:
Testes da componente Aircraft Management com 3 réplicas (SIDIS Assignment 1).
Pré-requisito: a partir de code/, `./scripts/start-replicas.sh aircraftmanagement` (ou `.\scripts\start-replicas.ps1 -Service aircraftmanagement`). Os dados de demonstração vêm das propriedades aisafe.bootstrap.* (cada réplica carrega dados diferentes).
A pasta 6 (US203, US204, US206) precisa também do Flight Routes: `-Service flightroutes -Profiles demo`.
Usar o environment AircraftManagement.postman_environment.json e correr as pastas por ordem (a pasta 0 gera os tokens).
Antes da pasta 7, PARAR a réplica 2 (porta 8181).
Os pedidos que criam dados usam valores aleatórios, por isso a coleção pode ser corrida mais do que uma vez (reiniciar as réplicas repõe os dados de demonstração).

exec: pm.test("B1a fields present and not null", () => { ["registrationNumber","modelName","seatingCapacity","status"].forEach(f => pm.expect(a[f], f).to.not.be.null.and.not.be.undefined); });
pm.test("status is one of the contract values", () => pm.expect(["AVAILABLE","IN_FLIGHT","UNDER_MAINTENANCE","INACTIVE"]).to.include(a.status));

item.name: B1b — model A320 on replica 1 (stored locally)

exec: pm.test("B1b fields", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.modelName).to.eql("A320"); pm.expect(m.maximumRange).to.be.a("number").and.to.be.above(0); });

item.name: US103 — CS-TUC asked to replica 1 (stored in replica 2)

exec: pm.test("found in peer", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.registrationNumber).to.eql("CS-TUC"); pm.expect(a.modelName).to.eql("A330"); });

item.name: US103 — CS-TUE asked to replica 2 (stored in replica 3)
US103 — same aircraft asked to replica 3 (same answer)
B1b — model A330 asked to replica 1 (stored in replica 2)

exec: pm.test("model from peer", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.modelName).to.eql("A330"); pm.expect(m.maximumRange).to.eql(11750); });

item.name: US103 — unknown aircraft → 404 in every replica

exec: pm.test("aircraft of all three replicas", () => { const regs = p.content.map(a => a.registrationNumber); ["CS-TUA","CS-TUB","CS-TUC","CS-TUD","CS-TUE","CS-TUF"].forEach(r => pm.expect(regs).to.include(r)); });
pm.test("sorted by registration", () => { const regs = p.content.map(a => a.registrationNumber); pm.expect(regs).to.eql([...regs].sort()); });
pm.test("no duplicates", () => { const regs = p.content.map(a => a.registrationNumber); pm.expect(new Set(regs).size).to.eql(regs.length); });

item.name: US104 — all aircraft from replica 3 (same answer)

exec: pm.test("same fleet", () => { const regs = pm.response.json().content.map(a => a.registrationNumber); pm.expect(regs).to.include.members(["CS-TUA","CS-TUC","CS-TUE"]); });

item.name: US104 — filter by model (applied in every replica)

exec: pm.test("only A330", () => { const c = pm.response.json().content; pm.expect(c.map(a => a.registrationNumber)).to.have.members(["CS-TUC","CS-TUD"]); c.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.modelName).to.eql("A330")); });

pm.test("every item under maintenance", () => { const c = pm.response.json().content; pm.expect(c.map(a => a.registrationNumber)).to.include("CS-TUB"); c.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("UNDER_MAINTENANCE")); });

pm.test("2022 aircraft of replica 3", () => { const c = pm.response.json().content; pm.expect(c.map(a => a.registrationNumber)).to.include.members(["CS-TUE","CS-TUF"]); c.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.manufacturingDate.substring(0,4)).to.eql("2022")); });

item.name: US101 — register a model on replica 1

exec: pm.test("created model", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.modelName).to.eql(pm.environment.get("newModel")); pm.expect(m.maximumRange).to.eql(4000); });

item.name: US101 — new model visible from replica 3
US101 — duplicate model A330 on replica 1 (A330 is in replica 2) → 409

exec: pm.test("one message per invalid field", () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("modelName"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("seatingCapacity"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("maximumRange"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("cruisingSpeed"); });

item.name: US102 — register an aircraft on replica 1 with model E190 (stored in replica 3)

exec: const letters = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"; let s = "CS-"; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { s += letters[Math.floor(Math.random()*letters.length)]; } pm.environment.set("newReg", s);

pm.test("created AVAILABLE by default", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.registrationNumber).to.eql(pm.environment.get("newReg")); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("AVAILABLE"); pm.expect(a.seatingCapacity).to.eql(98); });

item.name: US102 — new aircraft visible from replica 3
US102 — duplicate CS-TUC on replica 1 (CS-TUC is in replica 2) → 409
US102 — manufacturing date in the future → 400
US105 — status of CS-TUC changed through replica 1 (owner: replica 2)

exec: pm.test("updated by the owner", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.registrationNumber).to.eql("CS-TUC"); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("UNDER_MAINTENANCE"); });

item.name: US105 — change stored in the owner (read from replica 2)
B3b — Maintenance Technician sets CS-TUC back to AVAILABLE
US105 — lower-case status is accepted (new aircraft → in_flight)
Backoffice cannot change an aircraft status (US105) → 403
Maintenance Technician cannot see compatible routes (US203) → 403
Peer request with wrong service key → 401
Valid peer request → only local data (unpaginated list)

exec: pm.test("plain list with local aircraft only", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l).to.be.an("array"); const regs = l.map(a => a.registrationNumber); pm.expect(regs).to.include("CS-TUA"); ["CS-TUC","CS-TUD","CS-TUE","CS-TUF"].forEach(r => pm.expect(regs).to.not.include(r)); });

item.name: 6. Integration with Flight Routes (US203, US204, US206) — needs Flight Routes running
US206 — operational hours of the fleet (ATCC)

exec: pm.test("every aircraft of the fleet is listed", () => { const regs = p.content.map(r => r.registrationNumber); ["CS-TUA","CS-TUB","CS-TUC","CS-TUD","CS-TUE","CS-TUF"].forEach(r => pm.expect(regs).to.include(r)); });

pm.test("list of ACTIVE routes within the aircraft limits", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l).to.be.an("array"); l.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("ACTIVE"); pm.expect(r.minRange).to.be.at.most(6100); pm.expect(r.minCapacity).to.be.at.most(180); }); });

item.name: US203 — aircraft of replica 2 asked to replica 3 (capacity 290, range 11750)

exec: pm.test("at most 5 rows, descending", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.be.at.most(5); for (let i = 1; i < l.length; i++) pm.expect(l[i-1].totalMinutes).to.be.at.least(l[i].totalMinutes); });

item.name: US204 as Backoffice (documents observation O1: Flight Routes accepts only ATCC today)

exec: pm.test("200 once Flight Routes accepts Backoffice, otherwise 403 (contract Q4)", () => pm.expect([200, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 7. Replica failure — STOP replica 2 (port 8181) before running this folder
US104 — replica 2 down: partial answer from replica 1

exec: pm.test("aircraft of replicas 1 and 3 only", () => { const regs = pm.response.json().content.map(a => a.registrationNumber); pm.expect(regs).to.include.members(["CS-TUA","CS-TUE"]); pm.expect(regs).to.not.include("CS-TUC"); });

item.name: US104 — replica 2 down: same answer from replica 3
US103 — aircraft of the stopped replica → 404 (flagged as partial)
US102 — registration still possible on a live replica
US105 — command for an aircraft of the stopped replica → 503
